source.title: Scope RDC MAX_TABS launch guard to controlled ChatGPT tabs
source.objective: The launch guard counts all 70 normal-Chrome tabs against MAX_TABS=20, although only 22 are responsive and the supervisor did not cause proliferation. Create scoped guard work; no verified dependency or priority change.
